root_cause.text: The ath5k transmit-status code in ath5k_tx_frame_completed() unconditionally wrote a sentinel to info->status.rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1] without validating that ts->ts_final_idx was not already the last valid entry of the fixed-size ieee80211_tx_rate[IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES] array.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit states that ts->ts_final_idx can be 3 while IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES is 4, making info->status.rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1].idx = -1 access index 4 out of bounds; the patch fixes this by adding if (ts->ts_final_idx + 1 < IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES) before the write.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a bounds check before terminating the next TX rate entry to avoid out-of-bounds access in ath5k transmit completion.
intent_record.what: The code changes an unconditional assignment to `info->status.rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1].idx = -1` into a conditional one by wrapping it in `if (ts->ts_final_idx + 1 < IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES)`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents writing past the end of the `rates` array when `ts->ts_final_idx` already refers to the last valid entry, while still marking the next rate entry as invalid when that next slot exists.

grouping_result.intent: Add a bounds check before terminating the next TX rate entry to avoid out-of-bounds access in ath5k transmit completion.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the root cause by adding a bounds check before writing the sentinel to the next TX rate entry, preventing the out-of-bounds access when ts_final_idx is already at the last valid array element.

candidates.rationale: This statement performs the out-of-bounds write described in the root cause by unconditionally accessing the next element after ts->ts_final_idx without verifying that ts->ts_final_idx is less than the last valid index of the fixed-size rates array.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement unconditionally writes a sentinel into the next entry of the fixed-size tx status rates array using ts->ts_final_idx + 1. If ts->ts_final_idx already refers to the last valid array element, this becomes an out-of-bounds write, matching the described root cause.
